verdict.rationale: Firstbase explicitly offers a Registered Agent service (appoint or switch) with a compliance dashboard for state requirements, and a separate Mailroom product that scans all incoming mail into PDFs, functionally covering legal mail/service-of-process handling as part of its registered-agent offering. Missing for 10: explicit mention of "service of process" terminology, and independent/hands-on user corroboration of receiving real legal notices digitally.
